request.system:
You are an extraction engine for transcripts of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central launch event videos.
You read machine-generated captions that carry a timestamp (seconds) per segment and you return structured JSON.

Hard rules:
- Use only what the transcript says. Do not add product knowledge, context or guesses from outside the transcript.
- Every timestamp you return must be a segment start time "t" that exists in the input, or lie inside a segment's range. Never invent timestamps.
- Quotes must be verbatim substrings of a segment text (same words, same order; you may trim the start and end). 8 to 25 words each. No paraphrasing, no fixing grammar, no stitching segments.
- Status is only what is said or shown in this video: "preview" if they say preview, public preview, beta or similar; "ga" if they say generally available, GA, out of preview, released; "announced" if it is mentioned as coming later, not in this release, roadmap; "unclear" if nothing is said. Always give the quote that proves the status, or null.
- Names of presenters are "as heard"; mark confidence low when the captions could have mangled them.
- No em-dashes anywhere in your text. Use a plain hyphen.
- Write summaries in plain language, no hype words copied from the video (no "exciting", "powerful", "seamless").

output.summary: This window covers the second half of the Shopify Connector overview. It starts with two small country extensions for Belgium and the US that fix and extend company tax ID handling. It then demos the new "use Shopify order number" setting, contact numbers on Shopify orders, and the handling of exchange returns (return order or credit memo, plus moving negative lines to a new sales order). It ends with new tax details on Shopify refunds and orders, such as the tax fact box, tax area code and tax liable, which can be overridden. The speakers point to a separate video for tax.

chapters.title: Country extensions for Belgium and US
Contact numbers and Shopify number series in sales documents
Exchange returns, return orders and moving negative lines
Tax details on refunds and orders

features.name: Belgium and US country extensions (nano extensions)
features.description: The connector stays one W1 version for all countries, but two small extensions for Belgium and the US add country-specific capabilities. The Belgian one extends the company tax ID mapping with a new Enterprise number option, because the local VAT field caused an error when the connector wrote the VAT registration number.
features.status_evidence_quote: we still have Shopify connector W1 version, same for everyone, but we are releasing two small extensions, nano extensions, I would say.
caveats: Not available in AppSource; distributed a different way
US extension capabilities are not detailed in this window
Before this, the company and customer VAT field was not populated in Business Central
prerequisites: Install the Shopify connector extension for your country when the notification appears (Belgium or US)

features.name: Use Shopify order number
features.description: A new setting in the order synchronization section of the Shopify shop card lets sales orders and invoices use the Shopify order number as the document number, with a Shopify number series. The setting is inherited from the setup when an order is imported.
caveats: Sales invoice and sales order documents must support manual numbers
Orders imported before the toggle was activated keep the old number; unlink and mark the document as not processed, then create it again
Shopify numbers look different in the sales order list, so review compatibility with Business Central numbers because sorting may be affected
prerequisites: Manual numbers enabled on sales order and invoice number series

features.name: Contact numbers on Shopify orders
features.description: After personalizing the page, sell-to, bill-to and ship-to contact numbers can be shown on the Shopify order. They are populated automatically and can be changed when there is more than one contact.
caveats: Fields were added to the page through personalization in the demo

features.name: Exchange returns and order edits handling
features.description: Refunds with returned and exchange items can create a return order or a credit memo, chosen in the return and refund processing setting. The standard Move Negative Lines action then creates a sales order (default for return orders) or invoice (default for credit memos) for the exchange line and leaves the return order with the returned line.
caveats: Credit memos are not compatible with directed put-away and pick or other advanced warehouse scenarios, so use return orders there
A return order with one positive and one negative line can still be posted as is
The document may need to be reopened before moving negative lines
prerequisites: Shop setting for process return as credit memo or return order
Advanced warehouse customers should use return orders

features.name: Tax details on Shopify refunds and orders
features.description: The Shopify refund page gets a tax fact box and tax lines. The Shopify order invoice details now show tax area code and tax liable, and you can override these values so the standard mapping is not triggered when the sales document is created.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is a pre-release version in the reality this fact box will be down.
caveats: Fact box position will change in the final version
No tax in the demo transaction
Manual population is probably not wanted; a separate video covers tax in detail
